description: manni docs cite/index, the 30-second proof, run in a repo whose docs/limits.md cites nothing yet.

steps.description: Pin both ends of the sentence on line 9.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite add docs/limits.md:9 lib/limits.ts:2 --id fetch-timeout
runShell.stdio: /docs\/limits\.md: added fetch-timeout to frontmatter \(claim at line 19, sha256-[0-9a-f]+…; source lib\/limits\.ts:2 "export const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;"/
/fetch-timeout\s+:19 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 current[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

runShell.command: git -c user.name=Docs -c user.email=docs@example.com commit -qam "cite the fetch timeout"

steps.description: Someone raises the timeout to 30 seconds.

runShell.command: git -c user.name=Dev -c user.email=dev@example.com commit -qam "raise fetch timeout to 30s"

steps.description: The page has not changed, so metadata validation still passes.
The citation check does not: the source end changed, 1 commit, exit 1.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:19 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:2 changed since [0-9a-f]+, 1 commit[\s\S]*1 file checked, 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 finding/
